description: Master tracking system for permanent visual modifications to character sprites that persist for the entire game after acquisition

design_philosophy.purpose: Permanent cosmetic changes serve as visible badges of the bros' poor decisions, creating running visual gags that pay off throughout the game
design_philosophy.implementation: Sprite overlays applied to base character sprites when conditions are met
design_philosophy.comedy_function: NPCs can comment on these changes, creating callback humor

cosmetic_changes.actual_description: A duck holding a scythe. Clearly a duck. NOT a skeleton.
cosmetic_changes.pilsner_believes: An authentic European death skeleton from the ancient Astronomical Clock

acquisition.location: Euro Ink 4 Less, Astronomical Cock-Up Square, Debaucheryville

guaranteed_visible_outfits.description: Tattoo ALWAYS visible with these equipped

outfits.equipment_ref: Hemp Necklace Visible Through Deep V-Neck
outfits.reason: Low back as well as front

occasional_visibility_outfits.description: Tattoo peeks out 15-30% of idle frames

action_triggered_visibility.description: Tattoo becomes visible during these animations regardless of outfit

actions.context: Picking up items, examining low objects

random_idle_visibility.description: Shirt rides up occasionally during standard idle loop
random_idle_visibility.frame_count: 1-2 frames per idle cycle show tattoo peeking
